scope: Pinned original primary upstream license files; original bytes, copyright notices and URLs retained in upstream-evidence.json. This is an evidence review, not a blanket distribution-compliance certification.

sarpy.obligation: Retain NGA copyright and permission/warranty notices.

spectral.obligation: Retain Thomas Boggs copyright and permission/warranty notices.

PyWavelets.obligation: Retain Filip Wasilewski and PyWavelets developer notices; keep bundled component notices separately.

scikit-image.license: BSD-3-Clause with component BSD-2-Clause and MIT notices
scikit-image.obligation: Retain the full component-specific copyright, redistribution, non-endorsement and warranty notices.

pyspectral.obligation: Retain license and applicable NOTICE/attribution files; mark modifications when distributing modified files.

OrfeoToolBox.obligation: Retain license and applicable NOTICE/attribution files; native dependency licenses remain separate identities.

mintpy.obligation: Original header explicitly permits version 3 or later. Retain notices and GPL text; redistribution requires the applicable corresponding-source and licensing obligations. Private use here does not establish approval of any future redistribution.

transitive_dependencies: Original installed license files and metadata are hashed in the full environment lock. No blanket reviewed=true assertion is made for the entire transitive dependency graph.
